designs.title: Qwen3-8B ROM + KV die, 8K context, AR (TP4 pairs)
designs.exactness: reference-level only (2026-10-10): the layer / token exactness was proven on the unstationed reference topology (1-edge co-located VM read); the TP sequencer assumes a 1-edge VM read and the r22k floorplan lacks the sequencer <-> VM all-reduce read bus, so die-level exactness and the AR read cost are unproven until the stationed re-proof (claude-takeover qwen-1010.log)
